metric: Expert majority labels (52 equivalent, 18 inequivalent): equivalent pairs proved plus inequivalent pairs refuted.
correctness: Wrong is a proof of a pair the experts call inequivalent. 44 pairs the experts call equivalent are refuted on a schema-valid database (label disputes, listed in the docs).
caveats: No keys are given to the prover (Spider lists only the first column of a composite key), so key-dependent rewrites stay unknown. The experts judged intent on realistic data; a refutation needs only one valid database.
